articles.summary: State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) today announced the following conference calls to review its quarterly financial results: Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2026 Friday, January 15, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET (previously announced) First-Quarter 2027 Friday, April 16, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET Second-Quarter 2027 Wednesday, July 14, 2027 at 10:00 a.m. ET Third-Quarter 2027 Friday, October 15, 2027 at 11:00 a.m. ET The quarterly financial results will be released at approximately 7:30 a.m. ET on the day of the associated conference call. Materials will be available on State Streets Investor Relations website, http://investors.statestreet.com , prior to each call. Details on how to participate will be provided closer to each scheduled date. For those unable to listen to the live webcast, a replay will be available on the website for approximately one month. articles.summary: Framework brings together State Streets broad capabilities to support growth across the Middle East Dubai/Abu Dhabi, UAE , 17 November 2026 : State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) and Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the Middle East, North Africa, Trkiye and South Asia (MENATSA) region, announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) under which the firms will explore opportunities to expand their relationship which spans more than a decade across State Streets global capabilities. State Street has provided fund administration and custody services to Emirates NBD Asset Management for more than a decade. The MOU creates a framework for the firms to explore opportunities across a broader set of capabilities, including the evolution of Emirates NBD Asset Managements operating model, potential investment solutions and market products, digital innovation and support for the growth of Emirates NBDs wealth business. articles.summary: State Street Corporation (NYSE:STT) today announced a cash dividend on each of the below outstanding series of non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock: Series G (represented by depositary shares, each representing a 1/4000th interest in a share of Series G preferred stock). The cash dividend is in the amount of $1,352.36 per share of Series G preferred stock (resulting in a distribution of approximately $0.338090 per depositary share) and is payable on December 15, 2026 to the holders of record of the Series G preferred stock at the close of business on December 1, 2026.
